ModMetaData.name: 联合轻工 BWM 订单剪贴板修复 / UFLI BWM Clipboard Fix
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
修复联合轻工读取 Better Workbench Management 订单剪贴板时把 BillCopyPasteHandler 字段误当属性、以及 List 泛型转换失败的问题，恢复 BWM 复制订单后在联合全息打印机中粘贴。不修改工坊文件、原 DLL 或存档；保留打印机自身与原版剪贴板优先级，不改变生产逻辑。目标接口变化时跳过补丁；上游修复后应停用。
Repairs UFLI's field lookup and generic-list conversion when importing copied bills from Better Workbench Management. Preserves native clipboard precedence and paste validation. Independent Harmony sidecar; no Workshop files, original DLLs or saves are modified. Revalidate on upstream updates and remove when UFLI includes the fix.
